in_marathi.name: Chandraram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon God's Ruler
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandraram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। 1. The name Chandraram is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chandra' which means 'moon' and 'Ram' which means 'ruler'. 2. In Hindu mythology, Chandraram is considered as a divine name representing the ruler of the moon. 3. It is also believed that the name bestows the blessings of Lord Chandra, the deity of the moon.
